description.value: Neighbourhood Brewing is an independently owned craft brewery and tasting room in downtown Penticton, BC, producing a rotating lineup of core and seasonal beers alongside a kitchen inspired by Mexican cuisine. The brewery features a seasonal outdoor patio with heaters and a fireplace, and is dog-friendly on the patio — a welcome pit stop after a ride through the Okanagan. Their beer is also distributed widely across BC liquor stores and local establishments.

address.value: 187 Westminster Avenue W, Penticton, BC V2A 1J7
